title: Imagine If:
title_short: Tin Can · Courtney · We're Always Evolving
length: about 33 s + end card (about 28 s without the optional line)
headline: Kalindi says Search's own line down the string. A stranger answers it: violence is not inevitable, because we are always evolving.
story: Kalindi sits on a bench in Central Park with two tin cans and a string. She tells Courtney the line Search says all the time: conflict is inevitable, but violence is not. Does she agree?

Courtney says it back slowly. Then her answer: she does not think violence is inevitable. We are animals with animal impulses, but we are still evolving. We are always evolving. It is the only tin can piece where a stranger answers the peacebuilding question. One person, about 28 to 33 seconds. Hopeful, not generic.

Show the bench and the string under Kalindi's question, so a new viewer knows what this is.
Let Courtney say her line slowly. Keep her thinking.
Cover every trim with people walking past the string. Never a held frame.
